# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-22 from the 2026-11-22 Hub dump.

- 3,256,633 models tracked, 941,309 declare a base model, 974,712 parent links, 93,660 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.

## Files

- dist/parents.json: every model with descendants, compact columns
